{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Porcellus.png|thumb|right|250px|A chef]]
{{Quote|It's no good. I can't reach the ''junction terminal''. The access tube isn't wide enough.''"<br />"''Wrrgrruunnt!''"<br />"''Sure, I had a ''personal chef'' on Cloud City. What's your point?|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Drone Alone">{{SWComicCite|7.10|Drone Alone}}</ref>}}
A '''chef''' or '''cook''' was an individual who specialized in the cooking and preparation of food. Notable chefs throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] included [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]], [[Slabba Drewl]], [[Tavvar Va'ran]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zao]], [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]], [[Handree Braman]], and [[Vondri Deeq]], among others. The [[434-FPC Personal Chef Droid]] was a chef [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Those who demonstrated advanced capability in the field were given the title of [[Master Chef]].

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
Another such title was [[galactic gourmet]], awarded to the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] chef [[Gammy]] after he spent many years training.<ref name="return">''[[Jedi Academy: Return of the Padawan]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
